<Heading

  children={"Get fleet-wide idle-gap / utilization for a TaskType over a trailing window"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/task-types/{taskType}/utilization"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Measured task time vs. measured idle time (between-task waits) for one TaskType, plus the still-running open-gap contribution for anyone currently idle (computed at read time, never persisted). Always returns 200, including a zero-count result for a TaskType this service has never observed.
